description: Submit a 3-lane genie compile for the Behavioral Gate's self-hosted runner. Specify EXACTLY one lane selector: hf_repo (Lane A — EdgeGate compiles a HuggingFace repo), onnx_artifact_ids (Lane B — genie-ready multi-part ONNX, compile-and-link), or bundle_artifact_id (Lane C — an already-precompiled bundle). Returns a job_id to poll. Requires workspace admin access.

bundle_artifact_id.description: Lane C: an already-precompiled genie bundle artifact id.

device_id.description: Target device chipset id the bundle compiles for, e.g. sm8550.

hf_repo.description: Lane A: a HuggingFace repo id EdgeGate compiles into a genie bundle.

onnx_artifact_ids.description: Lane B: genie-ready multi-part ONNX artifact ids to compile-and-link.

name: edgegate_compile_genie
